ModuleDescription: Runs the VIVE Facial Tracker without any VIVE software: direct camera access and SRanipal's own lip model on the GPU.
UsageInstructions: Needs lip_opencl.params once (see the project's docs/model-sources.md). It is kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Unvived\models, so reinstalling the module does not lose it. Quit SRanipal if it is still installed.
